newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine gov't to sign post sale decree next week.
newsitem.headline: Argentine gov't to sign post sale decree next week.

text.p: Argentine President Carlos Menem said Friday he will sign a decree to privatize the country's state postal service next week.
"Next week we will have finished a report on the issue," Menem told local radio.

On Thursday, Julio Caceres, the coordination secretary at the ministry, said the privatization project and terms that establish the 30-year concession have already been signed by Economy Minister Roque Fernandez.
He said that there will be minimum investment requirements for the winner of the tender although he did not mention any figures. In addition, postal rates will have to decrease until 2003.
